name: Due Process at Machine Speed
description: A constitutional framework for machine-speed government decisions. Not AI ethics; procedural due process applied to automated public power.
doctrine_block: NO MANIFEST, NO AUTHORITY. NO REPLAY, NO AUTOMATED POWER. NO PLAIN-LANGUAGE EXPLANATION, NO AUTOMATED AUTHORITY. A DELAY THAT FUNCTIONS AS A DENIAL IS A DECISION.
plain_language_doctrine: When an automated system significantly affects liberty, property, benefits, eligibility, or substantial rights, due process requires meaningful notice, plain-language explanation, timely human review, preserved appeal rights, and a reviewable record of the machine-mediated decision.
cite_as: Due Process at Machine Speed Framework v0.1.0 (2026), https://jsonwisdom.github.io/AL/dist/pdf/due-process-at-machine-speed.pdf
